source: Bantay-written questions about Philippine food, places, animals and words. Nothing was copied from a quiz site.

questions.q: Which fruit is called the king of fruits in Davao?
questions.why: Davao is famous for durian, and Mindanao grows most of the country's. Mangosteen is called the queen of fruits.

questions.q: Which bird is the national bird of the Philippines?
questions.why: The Philippine eagle is one of the biggest eagles in the world.

questions.q: Which city is called the Tuna Capital of the Philippines?
questions.why: Big tuna catches land at the General Santos fish port.

questions.q: Which volcano is known for its almost perfect cone shape?
questions.why: Mayon is in Albay. Its smooth cone is on many postcards.

questions.q: Which is the highest mountain in the Philippines?
questions.why: Mount Apo near Davao is the highest. Pulag is the highest in Luzon.

questions.q: In which province can you meet the tiny tarsier?
questions.why: Bohol has a tarsier sanctuary. The tarsier is small enough to sit on your hand.

questions.q: What is the national flower of the Philippines?
questions.why: Sampaguita smells sweet, and people make it into garlands.

questions.q: Which tree is the national tree of the Philippines?
questions.why: Narra wood is strong and has a red color.

questions.q: What does "salamat" mean?
questions.why: Salamat po is a polite way to say thank you.

questions.q: What does "kumusta" mean?
questions.why: Kumusta comes from the Spanish words for how are you.

questions.q: What does "araw" mean?
questions.why: Araw means sun, and it also means day.

questions.q: What does "bahay" mean?
questions.why: Bahay kubo is the little hut made of bamboo and nipa.

questions.q: About how many islands does the Philippines have?
questions.why: There are more than 7,000 islands, and people live on about 2,000 of them.

questions.q: What is the Filipino name for the whale shark?
questions.why: Butanding is a gentle giant. It eats tiny sea animals. Pawikan is a sea turtle.

questions.q: In which province are the Banaue Rice Terraces?
questions.why: The terraces in Ifugao were carved into the mountains about 2,000 years ago.

questions.q: In which province is the Puerto Princesa Underground River?
questions.why: You ride a small boat into the cave. Bats live inside.

questions.q: The first jeepneys were made from old what?
questions.why: After World War II, people turned army jeeps into colorful rides.

questions.q: Which fruit gives sinigang its usual sour taste?
questions.why: Sampalok is tamarind. Some cooks also use kalamansi or guava.

questions.q: Which two things give adobo its taste?
questions.why: Vinegar and soy sauce, with garlic and bay leaves. The vinegar also helps it keep.

questions.q: What does "halo-halo" mean?
questions.why: It is a cold dessert with ice, milk and sweet toppings all mixed together.

questions.q: What color do the Chocolate Hills of Bohol turn in the dry season?
questions.why: The grass on the hills dries up and turns brown, like chocolate.

questions.q: Which fruit is the national fruit of the Philippines?
questions.why: Philippine mangoes are known for being very sweet.

questions.q: General Santos sits on which bay?
questions.why: Sarangani Bay is rich in fish, especially tuna.

questions.q: What does "puso" mean?
questions.why: Puso is the heart. It is also the name of rice cooked in a woven leaf pouch.
